## 1. Problem Statement
<!-- A clear and concise description of what problem this feature solves. -->

## 2. Proposed Solution & Scope
<!-- A detailed description of the intended feature, its behavior, and user workflow. -->

## 3. Tool / Feature Category
- [ ] Orientation & Alignment (Crop, Resize, Rotate, Flip, Stretch)
- [ ] Simple Adjustments (Exposure, Contrast, Saturation, etc.)
- [ ] Precise Selection & Masking (Lasso, Background Removal, Transparency)
- [ ] Advanced Retouching (Healing Brush, Clone Stamp, Content-Aware Fill)
- [ ] Preset Filters
- [ ] Workflow / History / Tabs / Storage
- [ ] AI Integration (Pollinations.ai)
- [ ] UI / Layout / Responsive

## 4. Affected Components, Files & Services
<!-- List relevant files, components, hooks, or shaders if known (e.g., src/features/adjustments/...) -->

## 5. Acceptance Criteria
<!-- Verifiable checklist of requirements that must be met for this issue to be closed. -->
- [ ] Criterion 1
- [ ] Criterion 2
- [ ] Responsive UI verified on Desktop and Mobile
- [ ] Performance impact verified (60fps canvas / memory limits)

## 6. Testing & Validation Strategy
- [ ] Unit tests for math/utilities
- [ ] Component/render integration tests
- [ ] Manual visual verification

## 7. Security & Accessibility Considerations
- [ ] No remote data leakage (client-only processing)
- [ ] Keyboard navigation and ARIA attributes
